'''1998 Origins Open''' was a Star Wars CCG open qualifier for the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]], held at Origins in Columbus, Ohio. [[Dave Nanninga]] won. [[Zach Cowie]] finished 2nd.<ref name="list-53912">[http://groups.yahoo.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/message/53912 swccg-discussion message #53912], [[Alex Alcalde]] (31 July 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010509192606/http://groups.yahoo.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/message/53912 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
